facts.fact: Atlancis Technologies (Servernah Cloud) announces it has delivered and deployed a GPU-powered AI factory, built on OCP design principles with NVIDIA GPUs and offered as a cloud service, hosted at iXAfrica's NBOX1 campus in Kenya.
Atlancis Technologies says the NVIDIA GPU-powered Servernah AI factory is delivered and deployed at iXAfrica's NBOX1 data centre in Kenya, making GPUs locally accessible.
